value: error: Index for resource array inside cbuffer must be a literal expression
note: The reported symptom IS a diagnostic that the reporter says should not be emitted, so the usual polarity is inverted: match == the compiler rejected a shader the reporter believes should compile. This makes every loose predicate dangerous. `nonzero_exit` is useless (dxc returns E_FAIL 0x80004005 for every diagnosed error) and a bare `error:` is worse than useless across a 20-release history: any release predating anything in the repro emits some error and would score as a textbook reproduction. So this matches the FULL literal diagnostic text including the `error: ` prefix, which no unrelated failure can produce. `internal_failure` is deliberately not used: nothing here is crash-shaped. Controls: control-literal-index.hlsl (same cbuffer resource array, literal index -- differs in exactly the property the diagnostic names), control-global-array.hlsl (the reporter's own form C, dynamic index into a global resource array), control-hello.hlsl (per-release positive control proving the release can compile the profile at all). All three are declared --expect no-match, and every release is disqualified rather than scored if control-hello fails there.
